cost.title: Cost
cost.empty: No usage recorded yet. Numbers appear once the cost proxy and the power sampler have run for a day.
cost.savedSub: Haiku and Sonnet tokens re-priced at the Opus rate, minus what they cost
cost.localValueSub: tokens at Haiku to Sonnet API rates
cost.vsApi: Local AI power vs API equivalent
cost.vsApiSub: Ollama GPU electricity against the same tokens at API prices
cost.tapBar: Tap a bar for that day.
cost.claudeDay: Claude list price per day, by model
cost.planSub: share of the 5-hour and weekly window used
cost.localDay: Local AI tokens per day, by job
cost.noLocal: No local AI calls in this range.
cost.serverNotePlug: Server = what the Shelly plug measures for the whole machine minus the GPU (metered separately by nvidia-smi). Days before the plug was connected are CPU-load estimates. Now: {w} W at the wall.
cost.electricitySubPlug: whole server, measured by the plug
cost.serverNote: Server watts exclude the GPU (it is metered separately) and are an estimate between idle and max, scaled by CPU activity; not measured. Games are counted only if nvidia-smi lists their graphics processes; otherwise their power shows as Idle or Other.
cost.proxyOff: Cost proxy is not running: local AI (Ollama) usage is missing.
